resources.string:
On this phone, over Wi-Fi:
1. Turn on Developer options: Android Settings › About phone > tap Build number 7 times.
2. In Developer options, turn on Wireless debugging and tap Pair device with pairing code.
3. Pull down Parem's notification and type the 6-digit code into it.
Allow notifications so you can type the pairing code
In Wireless debugging, tap Pair device with pairing code, then type the 6-digit code here.
Grayscale is on. You can turn Wireless debugging off again.
That code did not work. Keep the pairing dialog open and type the 6-digit code it shows.
No pairing dialog found. Make sure Wi-Fi is on, tap Pair device with pairing code, and keep it open while you type.
Paired, but Wireless debugging is not reachable. Check it is still on and try again.
The phone refused the permission. Some phones need an extra switch in Developer options (for example USB debugging (Security settings)). Turn it on and try again.
Pairing failed. Try again with a new code.
If the switch is greyed out: App info > menu > Allow restricted settings.
Or with a computer: turn on USB debugging, plug the phone in, and open this page in Chrome or Edge:
